title: Plan from a spreadsheet
intro: Open an Excel workbook with jobs and people, or two CSV files. Review and confirm the columns before running a plan.
limits: Values only, no formulas. Up to 2 MB per file and 200 jobs and people combined. Files are read in this tab; running sends the planning model to your service. Larger plans may exceed the service’s search limit.
skipped: Rows before heading ({count}) are excluded. Review them before confirming.
name: Name
confirm: I confirm the columns, heading rows and values
mappingSaved: Column choices saved. No filenames or cell values were saved.
mappingNotSaved: Could not save column choices. Use unique headings and allow local storage.
ready: {jobs} jobs and {people} people ready for review.
invalid-file: Could not read this file. Check its format and try again. Any previous review remains available.
file-limit: Use a file under 2 MB with no more than 8 MB of expanded workbook content.
sheet-limit: Use at most 8 sheets, 204 source rows and 80 columns per sheet.
formula: Replace formulas with values, then reopen the workbook.
unsupported-file: Choose an .xlsx workbook or UTF-8 CSV. Macros and external links are not supported.
delimiter: The CSV separator or row structure is unclear. Use consistent comma or semicolon-separated columns.
issue_missing: Choose a source sheet and a column for every field.
issue_duplicate: Choose different sheets for jobs and people, and a different column for each field.
issue_text: Enter a name or required skill with 1–80 characters.
issue_skills: List up to 20 skills separated by commas.
issue_available: Use Yes/No, Oui/Non or Po/Jo. Blank or unknown availability must be corrected.
issue_capacity: Use a whole-number job limit from 0 to 200.
issue_limit: Use no more than 200 jobs and people combined.
issue_unmapped: This source row has values only in unmapped columns. Correct the mapping or source file; it has not been dropped.
